Single image/video, or a full frame sequence (local files/folder or URL pattern). Color space is auto-detected and converted for display.

Auto: EXR linear→sRGB; 16-bit TIFF often linear→sRGB; 8-bit TIFF/PNG/JPG/WebP = sRGB.

Type

Tracking opens per-character space for broadcast readability. Title lines usually want more air than names.

Package size & position

Same controls as the left panel — uniform scale/position for every title in this style. Prefer those sliders; they update the stage live.

Generate & download

Export uses the same Package size as the stage (left panel). Change size there — it applies to every title.

Animation

Motion blur is temporal multi-sample (true path blur), not a fake CSS filter. PNG sequence is the cleanest for Resolve/AE.

Default export is a full animated PNG sequence (ZIP) with motion blur — import into Resolve/AE at your FPS. Still PNGs are optional below.

Presets

Browser presets store theme, fonts, tracking, people, and a reference to the built-in 30Y logo (not the multi‑MB animation — that was blowing the 5 MB storage limit). Use Download JSON for a full portable backup including a custom logo.
